name: io.github.zoster81/mcp-file-tools
title: MCP File Tools
description: Secure encoding-aware filesystem tools with atomic writes, legacy encodings, and typed errors

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read files through the shared encoding/BOM-aware document pipeline, convert content to UTF-8, strip transport BOMs, and report BOM metadata

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read multiple files concurrently through the shared document pipeline with partial results and stable per-file error codes

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write through the shared document encoder and synced atomic mutation layer with conflict detection and no-replace creation

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit through the shared encoding/BOM-aware pipeline and synced atomic replacement; rejects detected concurrent changes and preserves byte-identical no-ops

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories with glob pattern filtering

tools.name: tree
tools.description: Compact deterministic tree through the shared secure walker; skips symlink, junction, and reparse-point escapes

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.description: Deterministic JSON tree through the shared secure walker (deprecated, use tree)

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Deterministic glob search through the shared secure walker; skips entries resolving outside allowed directories

tools.name: grep_text_files
tools.description: Deterministic regex search through the shared decoder and secure walker, including UTF-16 LE/BE and junction/reparse escape protection

tools.name: detect_encoding
tools.description: Auto-detect file encoding with confidence score and BOM detection

tools.name: detect_line_endings
tools.description: Detect crlf/lf/mixed/none after decoding the selected encoding, including UTF-16 LE/BE and MQL4/MQL5 sources; rejects explicit encodings that conflict with a Unicode BOM

tools.name: change_line_endings
tools.description: Convert LF/CRLF through synced atomic replacement while preserving encoding, BOM state, and all non-line-ending bytes

tools.name: manage_bom
tools.description: Detect BOMs or strip/add them through path-revalidated synced atomic replacement

tools.name: convert_encoding
tools.description: Convert through the shared text pipeline and transactional atomic mutation layer with rollback-aware backups and conflict detection

tools.name: list_encodings
tools.description: List all supported file encodings

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get file/directory metadata (size, times, permissions)

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create directories recursively (mkdir -p)

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories with platform-native no-replace commit

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copy a regular file through synced staging and atomic no-replace install while preserving mode and modification time where supported

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file after path revalidation and optimistic snapshot verification, then sync the containing directory where supported

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Show directories the server can access

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Execute supported scripts or executables inside allowed directories when explicitly enabled

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Execute an unrestricted shell command with an allowed working directory when explicitly enabled

tools.name: check_for_updates
tools.description: Check the latest release of the zoster81 fork using a bounded cache
